# dsh-desktop-pet
A pet for DeepSeek Harness: a DeepSeek-style whale or a pixel crab that perches on the top edge of t
he DSH input box and reacts to your sessions.
中文说明
| Right-click menu | Settings |
All the whale's states (working, waiting for approval, done, error, petted, hungry, asleep…):
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install it from the plugin market inside DSH. Settings → Desktop Pet has the switches.
## What it does
- **Reacts to the current session**: works while the agent runs, rings a bell when a tool call waits
for your approval (click it to jump to that session), plants a flag when a turn finishes, shows a r

ed dot on errors.
- **Eats tokens**: every finished turn feeds it `inputTokens + outputTokens` (cach

e reads don't count). It gets hungry, sleepy and sick over time.
- **Right-click menu**: feed a snac
k (3 a day), medicine when sick, pet it, send it travelling (it comes back 40–120 minutes later with

a postcard), status card, diary.
- **Perches on the input box**, following it when the page changes
; with no input box on screen it stands in the bottom-right corner. **Drag it** anywhere inside the

window and it stays there; drop it near the input box to perch again.
- **Settings**: whale or crab,
four sizes, three colour skins per character, reminders (noon, long sitting, end of day, late night
) and heart effects.
State and diary live in the browser's `localStorage`; nothing is sent anywhere.
## Desktop edition (optional, macOS / Windows)
The plugin above draws the pet inside the DSH window. There is also a floating edition that sits on
the outer top edge of the DSH window, gripping it with its fins, and can be dragged onto the desktop
. A plugin can't open windows of its own, so that edition patches the installed DSH app (`app.asar`)
with an install script — read docs/desktop-edition.md before using it. When it's installed, this pl
ugin hands its settings and session events to the floating pet instead of drawing a second one.
## Development

- `lib/` — client source; `tools/build.mjs` bundles it into `client.js` (no dependencies).
- `sprite
s/` — whale poses cut from the design sheets in `docs/whale-assets/` by `tools/cut_sprites.py`, inli

ned into `client.js` at build time.
- `pet/` + `tools/install.sh`, `tools/install-windows.ps1`, `too
ls/patch.mjs` — the desktop edition.
Not affiliated with DeepSeek. The whale is fan art based on the DeepSeek logo; the crab is based on
the Claude Code mascot.
